purpose: paired illustrative intervention, not independent anomaly-quality evaluation
injection_formula: modified Appliances(t) = original Appliances(t) + delta_wh only at indices 180..191
selection: Predeclared: first 3 x 50 Wh train IQR level-shift scale from Stage4; second reuses 300 Wh Kafka spike magnitude but sustained; final 450 Wh magnitude only if needed. Duration 12 is inside Stage4 level_shift duration 6..18.
stop_rule: stop at first variant with a ready positive during intervention absent in paired control at the same target timestamp; report pre-existing/continuing episodes separately; maximum three variants
rules: Only frozen combined-q99-v1-unanimous is integrated on this branch; standalone sustained_high/hybrid/low/telemetry rules are not installed or imported
timestamp_semantics: original timezone-naive dataset labels; delay in 600-second dataset intervals, not wall-clock pipeline latency
isolation: fresh uniquely named run/topic/group per control and variant; separate temporary PostgreSQL/Kafka; no production connection, SMTP sender, model writes or training
screenshots: same modified run/building/source, final 144 measurements; overview, reacting detector score/threshold, episodes, final decisions; paired control overview also saved
checks: only energy.value differs in modified copy
all wire records, ledger payload hashes and offsets match delivered Kafka data
API rows/flags/episode identity equal DB exports
real browser graphs and experimental episode status
